config.elytraautopilot.title: Elytra AutoPilot config
config.elytraautopilot.gui.showgui.desc: Toggle for if the flight GUI should be shown while flying
config.elytraautopilot.gui.guiX.desc: X position of the flight GUI
config.elytraautopilot.gui.guiY.desc: Y position of the flight GUI
config.elytraautopilot.gui.enabled.desc: Toggle to show whether autopilot is currently enabled
config.elytraautopilot.gui.height.desc: Toggle to show current height above ground
config.elytraautopilot.gui.heightreq.des: Toggle to show the requested flight height
config.elytraautopilot.gui.speed.desc: Toggle to show current flight speed
config.elytraautopilot.gui.avgspeed.desc: Toggle to show average speed during flight
config.elytraautopilot.gui.horizontalspe: Toggle to show horizontal component of speed
config.elytraautopilot.gui.flyto: Shows the destination you are flying to
config.elytraautopilot.gui.flyto.desc: Toggle to show the destination you are flying to
config.elytraautopilot.gui.eta.desc: Toggle to show estimated time of arrival
config.elytraautopilot.gui.useCycleAvgSp: Use average speed from the most recent complete pull-up/dive cycle instead of rolling window average, eliminating speed display fluctuation
config.elytraautopilot.gui.smoothEta.des: Apply smoothing to ETA display so it decreases near-linearly, eliminating fluctuation
config.elytraautopilot.gui.autoland.desc: Toggle to show whether auto landing is enabled
config.elytraautopilot.gui.landingstatus: Toggle to show the current landing status
config.elytraautopilot.gui.avoidanceStat: Toggle to show when the autopilot is avoiding terrain
config.elytraautopilot.flightprofile.dyn: Allow auto-flight to start below the minimum height when the predicted flight path ahead is clear
config.elytraautopilot.flightprofile.ris: Enable risky landing mode. Take a nosedive!
config.elytraautopilot.flightprofile.dir: Fly straight in to land whenever there is enough room instead of circling down. Falls back to the circling descent when the approach is too steep or blocked.
Descent angle used when landing without a destination (manual landing)
Steepest descent angle a straight-in landing may use. Steeper approaches fall back to circling down.
Minimum horizontal distance kept between the aircraft and the landing spot
Height above the ground at which a straight-in landing starts to flare
Pitch used while flaring. Negative values pitch the nose up to bleed speed before touchdown.
config.elytraautopilot.flightprofile.pow: Enable powered flight mode. Use fireworks while flying
config.elytraautopilot.flightprofile.ely: Automatically swap elytra when low on durability
config.elytraautopilot.flightprofile.cam: Decouple camera from flight control during autopilot, allowing free look
config.elytraautopilot.flightprofile.ely: At which durability an elytra is considered unusable and will either be replaced or forcelanded if enabled
config.elytraautopilot.strategy.strategy: Use precomputed pitch waveforms instead of the classic velocity-hysteresis controller. Climb and cruise phases switch automatically based on altitude.
config.elytraautopilot.strategy.cruiseAl: Below this altitude the climb strategy is used to regain height. Must be far enough above terrain to accommodate the ~74-block dive per cycle.
Above this altitude the cruise strategy is used for level, high-speed flight. The gap between min and max must exceed 134 blocks to avoid rapid phase switching.
config.elytraautopilot.trajectory.predic: Predict the flight path with the vanilla elytra movement model instead of extending the current heading in a straight line. Used by obstacle avoidance and straight-in landings.
config.elytraautopilot.trajectory.show.d: Draw the predicted flight path in the world while flying. It fades to red where it runs into terrain; while obstacle avoidance is active the line shows the escape it has chosen.
config.elytraautopilot.trajectory.previe: How far ahead the drawn trajectory reaches, in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second)
config.elytraautopilot.avoidance.obstacl: Look ahead along the flight path and pitch up (or down) to avoid terrain instead of flying into it
config.elytraautopilot.avoidance.lookahe: How many seconds of flight are scanned for obstacles. Longer looks further ahead and reacts earlier.
config.elytraautopilot.avoidance.clearan: Extra room, in blocks, kept between the aircraft and terrain while avoiding
config.elytraautopilot.avoidance.maxClim: Steepest nose-up angle obstacle avoidance may use
config.elytraautopilot.avoidance.maxDesc: Steepest nose-down angle obstacle avoidance may use when there is no room to climb
config.elytraautopilot.avoidance.pitchRa: How fast the autopilot may change pitch while avoiding an obstacle, in degrees per tick
config.elytraautopilot.avoidance.energyA: When the aircraft is too slow to climb over an obstacle, dive first to build speed and pull up once it has it, instead of stalling against the obstacle
config.elytraautopilot.avoidance.climbMi: Speed in blocks per tick (x20 = blocks per second) above which avoidance climbs straight away instead of diving for speed first
Land automatically when obstacle avoidance runs out of ways past the terrain
config.elytraautopilot.avoidance.giveUpT: How long, in ticks, avoidance may stay blocked before it gives up and lands
config.elytraautopilot.advanced.pullUpAn: Angle for pulling up during flight
config.elytraautopilot.advanced.pullDown: Angle for pulling down during flight
config.elytraautopilot.advanced.pullUpMi: Minimum velocity for pulling up during flight
config.elytraautopilot.advanced.pullDown: Maximum velocity for pulling down during flight
config.elytraautopilot.advanced.pullUpSp: Speed for pulling up during flight
config.elytraautopilot.advanced.pullDown: Speed for pulling down during flight
